steps.title: How this test works
steps.body: The TCF Canada writing test has three tasks: a message (60 to 120 words), a longer text (120 to 150 words) and an opinion (120 to 180 words). Here you practise the building blocks: greetings, sentences, connectors and structure.

steps.title: A model message
steps.body: Task 1 at A2: say who you are, ask politely, give a reason or a choice, thank, and sign.

examples.fr: Bonjour Julie, je voudrais changer mon rendez-vous de mardi. Je suis libre jeudi matin. Est-ce possible ? Merci beaucoup. Amina
examples.en: Hello Julie, I would like to change my Tuesday appointment. I am free Thursday morning. Is that possible? Thank you very much. Amina

steps.prompt: Which sentence politely asks for something?
options: Pourriez-vous m'envoyer le formulaire, s'il vous plaît ?
steps.explain: Pourriez-vous plus s'il vous plaît is polite.

steps.prompt: Choose the sentence in the past (passé composé).
steps.explain: J'ai visité is the passé composé.
